services.name: Vancouver City Skyline Tour
services.desc: Discover why the Vancouver City Skyline Tour is Seair’s most popular scenic flight. Departing from Vancouver Harbour, this unforgettable seaplane experience offers spectacular aerial views of one of the world’s most beautiful waterfront cities. Moments after takeoff, you’ll climb above Coal Harbour and downtown Vancouver as the city’s vibrant skyline, sparkling waterfront, and surrounding mountains come into view. Fly over the world-famous Stanley Park, cross the iconic Lion’s Gate Bridge, and enjoy breathtaking panoramas of the North Shore Mountains, Burrard Inlet, and the dramatic coastline leading toward Howe Sound. services.name: Nanaimo Kayak Adventure
services.desc: Escape the city and discover Vancouver Island from a whole new perspective with Seair’s Nanaimo Kayak Adventure. Your journey begins with a breathtaking seaplane flight from Vancouver Harbour, offering spectacular views of the Salish Sea, Gulf Islands, and Vancouver Island before arriving in Nanaimo. Meet your experienced guide and set out on a four-hour kayaking excursion through Nanaimo’s sheltered coastal waters. Paddle along scenic shorelines, explore quiet coves, and experience the region’s incredible marine environment while enjoying the peaceful beauty of British Columbia’s west coast. services.name: Event Charter
services.desc: Some of British Columbia’s most incredible destinations can’t be reached by road. Whether you’re heading to a remote fishing lodge, exploring a hidden inlet, enjoying a golf getaway, or escaping to a waterfront cabin, Seair can get you there quickly, comfortably, and with unforgettable views along the way. With flexible scheduling and access to destinations throughout the coast, your adventure begins the moment you take off. From secluded beaches and island communities to alpine lakes and wilderness retreats, we’ll help you make the most of your time exploring the West Coast. services.name: Nanaimo Whale Watching Experience
services.desc: Combine breathtaking seaplane travel with one of British Columbia’s most unforgettable wildlife experiences. Your adventure begins with a scenic flight from Vancouver Harbour, soaring above the Salish Sea and Southern Gulf Islands before landing in Victoria’s picturesque Inner Harbour. From there, join an experienced crew and knowledgeable marine naturalists for a three-hour whale watching excursion through the waters surrounding southern Vancouver Island. Keep watch for majestic orcas, humpback whales, harbour seals, sea lions, porpoises, bald eagles, and a variety of other marine wildlife while learning about the region’s unique ecosystem and ongoing conservation efforts. blurb: Seair Seaplanes offers scheduled seaplane flights, scenic tours, and private charters connecting Vancouver, Richmond (YVR), Victoria, Nanaimo, Salt Spring Island, and the Gulf Islands. Guests can enjoy aerial views of coastal landscapes, city skylines, and remote wilderness areas. The fleet includes modern and classic seaplanes accommodating from individual travelers to groups.
